This small plot has my enset and a few coffee bushes that I have tended for many years. I will not spend money on chemical fertilizer here because my plants grow well enough with the cow manure and compost I make at home. I propagate my enset from my own suckers and the coffee from local seedlings, so I do not need to buy improved seeds from the market. My wife and children help me with the weeding and harvesting, so I do not need to hire labor from outside.
